name: linalg_polar
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::linalg_polar(Tensor A) -> (Tensor U, Tensor H). Computes the right polar decomposition A=U@H without mutating A. Tests cover rectangular and batched matrices, noncontiguous input, empty and rank-deficient matrices, output metadata, reconstruction, orthogonality, Hermitian H, and invalid rank/shape/dtype inputs.
